sections.title: 1. DATA CONTROLLER

sections.title: 2. WHAT CATEGORIES OF PERSONAL DATA DO WE COLLECT?
content: We collect both data you voluntarily provide, for example, your email address or name, and data generated automatically when you use the Product, for example, your IP address or device information.
2.1 Data You Provide

You provide personal data when you: register or create an account; complete quizzes, questionnaires, or profile inputs; purchase a ACME Plan; contact Customer Support; respond to our emails; submit feedback; or report a technical issue.
2.2 Automatically Collected Data
How You Found Us: We collect information about how you arrived at our Product, including referral websites, advertising campaigns, or marketing links.
Cookies and Similar Technologies: We use cookies, local storage, and similar technologies to improve your experience. For more information, please see our Cookie Policy.

Browser and Device Information: We automatically collect technical information including your IP address, browser type, operating system, device model, language, time zone, referring URLs, and usage information.
Payment Information: Payments are processed by our third-party payment providers. We do not store your complete payment card details.
Personal Data We Process

sections.title: 3. FOR WHAT PURPOSES DO WE PROCESS YOUR PERSONAL DATA?
content: We process your personal data for the following purposes.
list: 3.1 Service Provision — To provide access to the ACME platform, digital content, subscription plans, personalized recommendations and content features.
3.2 Product Personalization — To generate personalized insights and recommendations, and improve your overall experience.
3.3 Research and Analytics — To understand how users interact with the Product and improve functionality.
3.4 Payment Processing — To process purchases, subscriptions, renewals, and refunds.
3.5 Fraud Prevention and Security — To detect unauthorized access, abuse, fraud, or other security incidents.
3.6 Communication — To send transactional emails, account notifications, customer support responses, and service-related communications.
3.7 Marketing — With your consent where required, we may send newsletters, promotional offers, product updates and educational materials.
3.8 Customer Support — To respond to questions, complaints, refund requests, and technical issues.
3.9 Advertising — To measure advertising performance and personalize marketing campaigns.
3.10 Legal Obligations — Where required by law, we may disclose information to governmental authorities or regulatory bodies.

sections.title: 4. DATA STORAGE AND TRANSFER
content: We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this Privacy Policy or as required by applicable law.

Where necessary, your personal data may be transferred outside the European Economic Area using appropriate safeguards, including Standard Contractual Clauses or other legally recognized transfer mechanisms.

sections.title: 5. THIRD-PARTY DATA RECIPIENTS
content: We share personal data only with service providers that help us operate our Product. They process personal data solely on our behalf and according to our instructions.
We never sell your personal data.

sections.title: 6. YOUR RIGHTS
content: Subject to applicable law, you have the right to:
list: access your personal data;
correct inaccurate information;
request deletion of your personal data;
restrict processing;
object to certain processing activities;
withdraw consent at any time where processing is based on consent;
receive your personal data in a structured, commonly used format;
lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority.

support@example.com

sections.title: 1. INTRODUCTION
content: This Cookie Policy (“Policy”) explains what cookies are, what types of cookies are used on our website, how they may be stored on your device, and how we use them. This Policy also covers the use of similar technologies, such as web beacons.
This Cookie Policy does not address the processing of your personal data in general. To learn more about how we handle personal data, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 2. WHAT ARE COOKIES?
content: Cookies are small text files that are sent to your web browser or stored in your device’s memory. A cookie typically includes the domain, web location, it came from, its expiration time, and a randomly generated unique identification number or other similar identifier.
A cookie may also contain information about your device, such as user settings, browsing history, and actions taken while using our website.

sections.title: 3. TYPES OF COOKIES
content: 3.1 Session Cookies
Session cookies expire when you close your browser window. ACME, Your Company Ltd uses these cookies to help you use our website more efficiently.
3.2 Persistent Cookies
Persistent cookies remain on your device after the browser is closed and help us remember your preferences and improve analytics.
3.3 First-Party Cookies
These cookies are set directly by ACME.
3.4 Third-Party Cookies
Third-party cookies are placed by our service providers. They include:
list: Security cookies
Analytics cookies
Advertising cookies

sections.title: 4. EXAMPLES OF THIRD-PARTY COOKIES
content: Google Analytics helps us understand website usage.
Microsoft cookies help evaluate advertising performance.
Zendesk cookies support customer service functionality.
Cloudflare cookies protect the website against malicious traffic.
We do not allow these providers to use your personal data for their own purposes.

sections.title: 5. SIMILAR TECHNOLOGIES
content: Web Beacons
Web beacons, also known as pixel tags, help us understand when users visit pages or open emails.
Software Development Kits (SDKs)
SDKs are small pieces of code embedded in applications that function similarly to cookies.
Snap Pixel helps measure advertising effectiveness on Snapchat.

sections.title: 6. WHY DO WE USE COOKIES?
content: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve website functionality, enhance security, analyze usage, remember preferences, and measure the effectiveness of our marketing campaigns.

sections.title: 7. HOW CAN YOU MANAGE COOKIES?
content: Most browsers allow you to manage cookies through browser settings.
Disabling cookies may affect the functionality of some parts of the Service.
Browser help pages:
list: Chrome
Microsoft Edge / Internet Explorer
Safari
Firefox
Opera

sections.title: 8. QUESTIONS AND CONTACT
content: If you have any questions about this Cookie Policy, please contact us:
support@example.com
